verdict.rationale: A GPU cloud platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only the Cloud Console, Terraform/OpenTofu, the REST/gRPC APIs, generated client libraries, and kubeconfig downloads for use with kubectl. kubectl is a third-party Kubernetes tool and the client libraries are developer building blocks, so neither counts as an official CoreWeave CLI. The only CLI mention says object management needs 'no CLI tools', which does not show that CoreWeave ships one.
